title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
title_zh: RECAST：基于可审计结构化痕迹的思维链重建

paragraphs.en: Large closed-source reasoning models expose only their final answers. The intermediate reasoning that produces those answers is hidden behind API surfaces, tool-call policies, and safety filters. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) extraction methods assume a side channel: a visible reasoning field, a scratchpad carried through tool calls, or a signed/encrypted reasoning block. We reproduce three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods and find that, on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 accessed through the standard chat-completions interface, all three return zero CoT tokens. The failure is structural rather than a bug: the reasoning field is absent, named tool selection is rejected, free-text scratchpad arguments are filtered, and no replayable reasoning block is exposed. We therefore take a different route. We present Recast , a reconstruction-based framework that conditions a decoder on the question and the target model’s final answer, reconstructs a first-person structured rationale, cleans it, and builds SFT-ready data. To the best of our knowledge, Recast is the first system to reconstruct CoT from frontier closed models such as Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-6.1, and Gemini 3 without using hidden reasoning channels. We instantiate Recast on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 and additionally obtain successful qualitative reconstructions on GPT-6.1 and Gemini 3 with the same answer-only protocol. The system is open-source and packaged as an agent skill: one prompt deploys it and runs the complete pipeline to produce SFT-ready CoT data. This preprint describes the system, its threat model, and a controlled artifact validation; it does not claim large-scale benchmark improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 大型闭源推理模型只暴露其最终答案。 产生这些答案的中间推理过程被隐藏在 API 接口、工具调用策略和安全过滤器之后。 现有的思维链（CoT）提取方法都假设存在一条侧信道：可见的推理字段、通过工具调用传递的草稿本，或带签名/加密的推理块。 我们复现了三种具有代表性的最先进提取方法，发现对于通过标准 chat-completions 接口访问的 Claude-Sonnet-5.5，这三种方法返回的 CoT 词元数均为零。 这种失败是结构性的而非程序缺陷：推理字段不存在，命名工具选择被拒绝，自由文本草稿本参数被过滤，也没有可重放的推理块可供使用。 因此，我们采取了一条不同的路线。 我们提出 Recast，一个基于重构的框架，它以问题和目标模型的最终答案为条件来约束解码器，重构出第一人称的结构化推理过程，对其进行清洗，并构建可用于 SFT 的数据。 据我们所知，Recast 是首个在不使用隐藏推理信道的情况下，从 Claude-Sonnet-5.5、GPT-6.1 和 Gemini 3 等前沿闭源模型中重构 CoT 的系统。 我们在 Claude-Sonnet-5.5 上实例化了 Recast，并使用相同的仅答案协议，在 GPT-6.1 和 Gemini 3 上额外获得了成功的定性重构结果。 该系统是开源的，并封装为智能体技能：一条提示词即可部署它，并运行完整流程以生成可用于 SFT 的 CoT 数据。 本预印本描述了该系统、其威胁模型以及受控的产物验证；它并不声称在大规模基准测试上有性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Frontier closed-source reasoning models are increasingly deployed as black boxes: a user supplies a question and receives a final answer, while the intermediate reasoning that produced the answer remains hidden. This is a problem for reasoning distillation. If we only observe answers, a student model can imitate what the teacher answered but receives little supervision on how to reason. If we can obtain an auditable rationale for each answer, we can instead train the student on the reasoning process itself.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿闭源推理模型越来越多地以黑盒方式部署：用户提交一个问题并获得最终答案，而产生该答案的中间推理过程则保持隐藏。 这对推理蒸馏来说是一个问题。 如果我们只观察答案，学生模型可以模仿教师回答了什么，但在如何推理方面几乎没有监督信号。 如果我们能为每个答案获得可审计的推理依据，我们就可以改为在推理过程本身上训练学生模型。

paragraphs.en: A growing line of work attempts to recover such rationales from closed models. The representative strategies are (i) forcing the model to place its reasoning into a custom tool argument ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , (ii) replaying a scratchpad state through multi-step tool injections ( Qu et al., 2026 ) , and (iii) replaying a signed or encrypted reasoning block with a weaker decoder ( Panfilov et al., 2026 ) . These methods are extraction methods: each assumes a side channel through which hidden reasoning becomes observable.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作试图从闭源模型中恢复此类推理依据。 具有代表性的策略包括：（i）强制模型将其推理放入自定义的工具参数中（Luo et al., 2026），（ii）通过多步工具注入来重放暂存区状态（Qu et al., 2026），以及（iii）用较弱的解码器重放经签名或加密的推理块（Panfilov et al., 2026）。 这些方法都是提取方法：每种方法都假设存在某个侧信道，使隐藏的推理变得可被观察。

paragraphs.en: We reproduced all three methods and evaluated them on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) through a standard OpenAI-compatible chat-completions interface. None of them produced a single CoT token. The failures were not implementation errors. The interface rejected named tool selection, filtered free-text tool arguments, omitted reasoning fields, and exposed no signed or encrypted reasoning block. In one probe, the target model consumed 9,949 completion tokens but returned only a final answer, confirming that substantial internal computation took place while the reasoning layer remained invisible.
paragraphs.zh: 我们复现了全部三种方法，并通过标准的 OpenAI 兼容聊天补全接口在 Claude-Sonnet-5.5（Anthropic，2026）上对它们进行了评估。 它们没有产生任何思维链（CoT）token。 这些失败并非实现错误所致。 该接口拒绝具名工具选择、过滤自由文本的工具参数、省略推理字段，且不暴露任何经签名或加密的推理块。 在一次探测中，目标模型消耗了 9,949 个补全 token，却只返回了最终答案，这证实了内部进行了大量计算，而推理层始终保持不可见。

paragraphs.en: Recast takes the only reliably observable signal—the final answer—and reconstructs a rationale from it. A decoder model receives the question and the target model’s complete answer, writes a first-person, stage-structured solution trace, and is then cleaned by a second model to remove dialogue, meta-commentary, and answer statements. A final-answer stage attaches a canonical answer, and a dataset builder produces chat-formatted SFT data with assistant-only supervision. Because the method only needs the final answer, it does not depend on hidden reasoning fields, tool-call state, or provider-issued encrypted blocks. The same protocol applies to any model whose answers are observable through a chat interface.
paragraphs.zh: Recast 采用唯一可靠可观测的信号——最终答案——并据此重构出一条推理理据。 一个解码器模型接收问题与目标模型的完整答案，撰写一份第一人称、分阶段结构的解题轨迹，随后由第二个模型进行清理，以去除对话、元评论和答案陈述。 最终答案阶段附加一个规范答案，数据集构建器则生成仅对助手部分施加监督的聊天格式 SFT 数据。 由于该方法只需要最终答案，它不依赖隐藏的推理字段、工具调用状态，或提供商发布的加密块。 同样的协议适用于任何其答案可通过聊天界面观测到的智能体。

paragraphs.en: We use “auditable” in a procedural sense: the reconstructed trace is organized into stages, is self-contained, does not mention dialogue/meta artifacts, and does not reveal the final answer before the derivation. The decoder is answer-conditioned, while the student sees only the question at inference. This is the property the title names; it is a condition for usable supervision, not a claim that the trace is the target’s true hidden computation.

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-thought prompting asks a model to produce intermediate reasoning before its final answer ( Wei et al., 2022 ) . This idea underlies a large family of distillation methods that train a smaller student on teacher-generated rationales. Distilling Step-by-Step trains a student on both rationales and answers ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) . STaR bootstraps rationales that lead to correct answers and iteratively fine-tunes on them ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) . Orca studies explanation-style distillation from stronger teachers ( Mukherjee et al., 2023 ) . LIMO and s1 show that carefully curated reasoning traces and test-time scaling can produce strong small reasoning models ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates large-scale reinforcement learning and distillation of reasoning traces ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) . These methods assume access to rationales, either from an open model, a visible thinking channel, or human annotation. Recast targets the setting in which none of these is available and only the final answer is observable.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链提示要求模型在给出最终答案之前先产生中间推理（Wei 等，2022）。 这一思想是大量蒸馏方法的基础，这类方法在教师生成的推理依据上训练更小的学生模型。 Distilling Step-by-Step 在推理依据和答案两者上训练学生模型（Hsieh 等，2023）。 STaR 自举出能导向正确答案的推理依据，并在其上迭代微调（Zelikman 等，2022）。 Orca 研究了来自更强教师的解释式蒸馏（Mukherjee 等，2023）。 LIMO 和 s1 表明，精心筛选的推理轨迹加上测试时扩展可以产生强大的小型推理模型（Ye 等，2025；Muennighoff 等，2025）。 DeepSeek-R1 展示了大规模强化学习以及推理轨迹的蒸馏（DeepSeek-AI，2025）。 这些方法都假设能够获得推理依据，无论是来自开放模型、可见的思考通道，还是人工标注。 Recast 针对的是这些条件都不具备、只能观察到最终答案的场景。

paragraphs.en: A recent line of work attempts to make hidden reasoning observable through the API surface. Luo et al. (2026) use a custom tool with a free-text argument and a forced tool choice to induce a “forced reasoning” trace. Qu et al. (2026) replay a scratchpad state through a sequence of tool injections and search over injection trajectories. Panfilov et al. (2026) replay signed or encrypted reasoning blocks with a weaker decoder model. These methods are important because they show that reasoning can sometimes be extracted without weight access. They are, however, extraction methods: each depends on a side channel that the deployment must expose. Our reproduction shows that on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 these channels are closed (Section 3 ). Recast is complementary rather than adversarial: it does not attempt to open the channel, but reconstructs a rationale from the answer that the channel does expose.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的一系列工作试图通过 API 表面使隐藏的推理变得可观察。Luo 等人 （2026）使用一个带有自由文本参数的自定义工具和强制工具选择来诱导出“强制推理”轨迹。Qu 等人 （2026）通过一系列工具注入重放草稿本状态，并对注入轨迹进行搜索。Panfilov 等人 （2026）使用更弱的解码器模型重放已签名或加密的推理块。 这些方法很重要，因为它们表明有时可以在无需访问权重的情况下提取出推理内容。 然而，它们都是提取方法：每一种都依赖于部署方必须暴露的某个侧信道。 我们的重现表明，在 Claude-Sonnet-5.5 上这些信道已被关闭（第 3 节）。 Recast 是互补的而非对抗性的：它并不试图打开该信道，而是从该信道确实暴露的答案中重构出一条理据。

paragraphs.en: A rationale that looks plausible need not faithfully reflect the computation that produced the answer. Lanham et al. (2022) introduce interventions that test whether a model’s stated reasoning actually causally affects its predictions. Turpin et al. (2023) show that chain-of-thought explanations can be biased by post-hoc rationalization and can omit influential features. Process supervision and verifier-based methods provide complementary signals for reasoning quality ( Lightman et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023a ) . We treat the reconstructed trace as a proxy , not as the model’s true hidden CoT, and we include answer consistency, leakage, length, and downstream utility as part of the evaluation protocol rather than assuming faithfulness from surface fluency.
paragraphs.zh: 看似合理的解释未必能忠实反映产生答案的计算过程。Lanham 等人 （2022）提出了一些干预方法，用以检验模型所陈述的推理是否真正对其预测产生因果影响。Turpin 等人 （2023）表明，思维链解释可能受事后合理化影响而产生偏差，并可能遗漏有影响的特征。 过程监督与基于验证器的方法为推理质量提供了互补的信号（Lightman 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2023a）。 我们将重构的轨迹视为代理，而非模型真实的隐藏思维链，并且我们把答案一致性、信息泄露、长度和下游效用纳入评估协议的一部分，而不是从表面的流畅性来假设其忠实性。

paragraphs.en: Recast differs from prior rationale distillation in two ways. First, it does not require a teacher rationale; it reconstructs one from the answer. Second, it does not require a hidden reasoning channel; it is designed for the answer-only interface that frontier deployments actually expose. The price is that the reconstructed trace is a proxy whose faithfulness must be evaluated, which we make explicit throughout.
paragraphs.zh: Recast 与以往的 rationale 蒸馏有两点不同。 首先，它不需要教师端的 rationale，而是从答案中重建出一个。 其次，它不需要隐藏的推理通道，而是专为前沿部署实际暴露的仅答案接口而设计。 代价在于重建出的推理轨迹只是一个代理，其忠实性必须经过评估，我们在全文中对此保持明确。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the reconstructed trace along four axes: (i) task utility , whether a student trained on the trace improves on held-out questions; (ii) answer consistency , whether the trace supports the reference answer; (iii) auditability , whether the trace is structured, self-contained, and free of dialogue/meta artifacts; and (iv) cost , the number of target, decoder, and cleaner calls per accepted sample. This preprint reports the system and a controlled artifact validation; the large-scale version of these axes is the subject of a follow-up study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿四个维度评估重建的轨迹：(i) 任务效用，即在该轨迹上训练的学生模型在留出问题上的表现是否提升；(ii) 答案一致性，即该轨迹是否支持参考答案；(iii) 可审计性，即该轨迹是否结构化、自包含且不含对话/元数据伪影；以及 (iv) 成本，即每个被接受样本所需的 target、decoder 和 cleaner 调用次数。 本预印本报告了该系统以及一项受控的产物验证；这些维度的大规模版本将在后续研究中探讨。

paragraphs.en: Recast turns a dataset of questions into SFT-ready reasoning data through five stages: (1) collect the target model’s answers, (2) reconstruct a structured rationale with a decoder, (3) clean the rationale, (4) extract the final answer, and (5) build and validate the SFT dataset. Figure 1 illustrates the flow. The four model roles are deliberately separated: a target model produces answers, a decoder reconstructs traces, a cleaner removes artifacts, and a student is trained on the result. Each role can use a different OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the default configuration uses a relay-served target model and DeepSeek for decoding and cleaning, but the code has no vendor-specific dependency.
paragraphs.zh: Recast 通过五个阶段将一个由问题组成的数据集转化为可用于 SFT 的推理数据：(1) 收集目标模型的回答，(2) 用解码器重建结构化推理依据，(3) 清洗推理依据，(4) 提取最终答案，(5) 构建并验证 SFT 数据集。 图 1 展示了该流程。 四种模型角色被刻意分开：目标模型生成回答，解码器重建推理轨迹，清洗器去除伪影，而学生在最终结果上进行训练。 每个角色可以使用不同的 OpenAI 兼容端点；默认配置使用中转服务提供的目标模型，并使用 DeepSeek 进行解码和清洗，但代码本身没有任何针对特定厂商的依赖。

paragraphs.en: We follow six design principles. Answer-only : the reconstruction stage never requires a hidden reasoning field. Role separation : target, decoder, and cleaner are independent, so a failure in one role does not invalidate the others. Dataset-aware elicitation : the prompt used to collect the answer is selected from the dataset profile, because some patterns elicit more explicit reasoning than others. Defensive cleaning : every generated trace passes through leak, length, and answer-consistency checks. Reproducibility : every run creates a timestamped job with logs, configuration, and a manifest. Automation : the same pipeline is exposed as a command-line tool and as an agent skill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循六项设计原则。 仅输出答案：重构阶段从不要求隐藏的推理字段。 角色分离：目标、解码器和清洗器相互独立，因此某一角色的失败不会使其他角色失效。 数据集感知的引导：用于收集答案的提示词从数据集配置文件中选取，因为某些模式比其他模式能引出更明确的推理。 防御性清洗：每条生成的轨迹都要经过泄露、长度和答案一致性检查。 可复现性：每次运行都会创建一个带时间戳的作业，包含日志、配置和清单。 自动化：同一流水线既以命令行工具的形式暴露，也以智能体技能的形式提供。

paragraphs.en: The router first checks a dataset-name map (e.g., MATH-500 and GSM8K map to math ; HumanEval and MBPP map to code ). paragraphs.en: Relay deployments may reject prompts that ask for structured reasoning. The collector therefore maintains a prompt chain: primary pattern, secondary pattern, medium prompt, and short prompt. Each prompt is tried first with the original question and then with a LaTeX-light variant. The attempt metadata (pattern, prompt variant, question variant) is stored with every record, so a job can be audited after the fact. A failed question does not abort the batch; it is recorded as an error and the pipeline continues.
paragraphs.zh: 中继部署可能会拒绝要求结构化推理的提示词。 因此，采集器维护了一条提示词链：主模式、次模式、中等提示词和简短提示词。 每个提示词都会先用原始问题尝试，再用轻量 LaTeX 变体尝试。 尝试元数据（模式、提示词变体、问题变体）会随每条记录一起存储，因此事后可以审计某个任务。 某个问题失败不会中止整个批次；它会被记录为错误，流水线继续运行。

paragraphs.en: The decoder receives the question and the target model’s complete answer. It is instructed to write in the first person, in the order in which the solution unfolds, and to cover five stages: task identification, requirement/diagnostic analysis, strategy selection, key derivation, and verification/closing. The prompt forbids dialogue and meta-commentary (“teacher”, “student”, “template”, “decode”, etc.), forbids restating the target answer verbatim, and forbids announcing the final answer in the middle of the trace. A compact version of the prompt is shown in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: The cleaner runs at temperature zero with a JSON response mode. It retries on parse errors and on leak/length violations, and it receives the specific violation as feedback. A rule-based safety net runs after the model: it strips residual meta sentences, removes explicit answer declarations, normalizes whitespace, and checks that the trace is not empty. The cleaned trace is stored as an overlay keyed by record; the raw decoded trace is never overwritten.
paragraphs.zh: 清理器在温度为零且使用 JSON 响应模式的设置下运行。 它会在解析错误以及泄露或长度违规时重试，并将具体的违规信息作为反馈接收。 一个基于规则的安全网在模型之后运行：它会剥离残留的元句子，移除显式的答案声明，规范化空白字符，并检查轨迹不为空。 清理后的轨迹以记录为键存储为覆盖层；原始解码轨迹永远不会被覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Each training sample needs a final answer. When the dataset provides a reference answer, the pipeline uses it directly (for MATH-500 and GSM8K, the test-set answer is used). When no reference is available, a hybrid extractor first applies pattern-based parsing and then asks a model to extract the final answer from the trace. Answers are normalized (whitespace, \boxed{} , units, and common equivalent forms) before being appended to the supervision target. The extraction method is recorded per record ( testset_reference , llm_extraction , or regex ), so a dataset can be filtered by answer provenance.

paragraphs.en: Before writing the splits, the builder removes duplicate questions, enforces minimum and maximum lengths, filters traces whose final answer disagrees with the reference, and checks for benchmark leakage. The output contains sft_train.jsonl , sft_val.jsonl , sft_test.jsonl , per-variant evaluation files, and dataset_stats.json with counts, dropped reasons, answer methods, and CoT sources. The built-in benchmark loaders use MATH-500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) and GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) . A validator checks the schema, duplicate rates, and leakage terms; a failed validation stops the job without deleting the raw artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 在写入切分数据之前，构建器会去除重复问题、强制执行最小和最大长度限制、过滤最终答案与参考答案不一致的轨迹，并检查基准测试数据泄漏。 输出包含 sft_train.jsonl 、 sft_val.jsonl 、 sft_test.jsonl 、每个变体的评估文件，以及包含计数、丢弃原因、答案方法和思维链（CoT）来源的 dataset_stats.json 。 内置的基准测试加载器使用 MATH-500（ Hendrycks 等人，2021 ）和 GSM8K（ Cobbe 等人，2021 ）。 验证器会检查模式、重复率和泄漏术语；验证失败将停止任务，但不会删除原始产物。

paragraphs.en: The complete workflow is packaged as an agent skill. The skill directory contains a SKILL.md entry point, a pipeline reference, and a small wrapper that locates the repository from any working directory. Installing the skill copies it into the host’s skill directory (project-level .dsh/skills or .claude/skills , or user-level ~/.codex/skills ); a new session then exposes the skill to the agent. The intended interaction is a single prompt such as “run CoT reconstruction on MATH-500 with model X”. The agent loads the skill, resolves the repository, chooses the dataset, target model, and pattern, runs the pipeline, and reports the job directory and summary.

paragraphs.en: To validate the artifact rather than the method’s accuracy, we ran the complete pipeline on a single MATH-500 item with Claude-Sonnet-5.5 as the target and the default DeepSeek roles. paragraphs.en: Beyond Claude-Sonnet-5.5, we applied the same answer-only protocol to GPT-6.1 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Gemini 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and obtained successful qualitative reconstructions: each run produced a structured, first-person trace that passed the cleaner and the dataset validator. paragraphs.en: The three reproduced methods are elegant when their side channel exists. They fail on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 not because the implementations are wrong, but because the deployment closes the channel: reasoning fields are omitted, named tool choice is rejected, free-text tool arguments are filtered, and encrypted blocks are absent. A system that depends on any one of these assumptions inherits a single point of failure. Recast removes the dependency altogether. It treats the final answer as the observable signal and reconstructs a rationale that is consistent with it. The trade-off is explicit: the reconstructed trace is a proxy, and its faithfulness must be tested rather than assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种复现方法在侧信道存在时是优雅的。 它们在 Claude-Sonnet-5.5 上失败，并不是因为实现有误，而是因为部署方式关闭了这条信道：推理字段被省略，按名称指定工具选择被拒绝，自由文本的工具参数被过滤，加密块也不存在。 依赖其中任何一条假设的系统都会继承一个单点故障。 Recast 则彻底移除了这种依赖。 它把最终答案视为可观测的信号，并重构出一个与该信号一致的理据。 这种权衡是明确的：重构出的轨迹只是一个代理，其忠实性必须经过检验，而不能想当然地假设。

paragraphs.en: The final answer constrains the space of plausible rationales: it fixes the destination and rules out derivations that end elsewhere. This is weaker than observing the true trajectory, but it is stronger than answer-only training, which provides no intermediate supervision. The decoder uses the answer as an anchor, not as a script: the prompt asks for a first-person derivation and forbids restating the answer as the explanation. The supporting pattern is also important. A pattern that elicits a detailed answer gives the decoder more material to reconstruct from; a terse answer leaves more of the rationale to the decoder’s prior.
paragraphs.zh: 最终答案约束了合理推理过程的空间：它固定了终点，并排除了终点在别处的推导。 这弱于观察真实的推理轨迹，但强于仅答案训练，后者不提供任何中间监督。 解码器将答案用作锚点，而非脚本：提示要求给出第一人称的推导，并禁止把答案复述作为解释。 支撑模式也很重要。 引出详细答案的模式为解码器提供更多可用于重建的材料；简略的答案则让解码器的先验承担更多推理过程的补全。

paragraphs.en: We use “auditable” in a procedural sense: the trace is structured into stages, is self-contained, does not mention teachers/students/templates/decoding, and does not announce the final answer in the middle of the derivation. Cleaning enforces these properties, and the validator checks length, answer consistency, and leakage. This is not a guarantee of faithfulness. A trace can be well structured and still be a post-hoc rationalization. We therefore treat auditability as a necessary condition for usable supervision, not as evidence that the trace equals the target’s hidden computation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在程序性意义上使用「可审计」一词：轨迹被结构化为若干阶段、内容自足、不提及教师/学生/模板/解码，且不会在推导中途公布最终答案。 清洗环节强制执行这些属性，校验器则检查长度、答案一致性和信息泄露。 这并不是对忠实性的保证。 一条轨迹可以结构良好，却仍然是事后合理化。 因此，我们将可审计性视为可用监督的必要条件，而不是轨迹等同于目标隐藏计算的证据。

paragraphs.en: Recast is a research tool for reconstructing auditable rationales from answers. It is not intended to bypass safety controls, extract proprietary reasoning at scale, or circumvent provider terms. The threat model in Section 3 assumes authorized access to an API and forbids filter evasion. Users are responsible for complying with their model provider’s terms and for not redistributing model outputs without permission. paragraphs.en: We studied the practical limits of extracting chain-of-thought from frontier closed models. Three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods—forced reasoning, scratchpad state replay, and encrypted-block replay—all returned zero CoT tokens on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 through a standard chat-completions interface. The failures follow from four interface constraints, not from implementation errors. We therefore proposed Recast , which reframes the problem from extracting a hidden rationale to reconstructing an auditable rationale from the final answer. Recast combines dataset-aware answer elicitation, first-person reconstruction, defensive cleaning, answer canonicalization, and a validated SFT data pipeline. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first system to reconstruct CoT from frontier closed models such as Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-6.1, and Gemini 3 without using hidden reasoning channels. The system is open-source and packaged as an agent skill, so a single prompt can deploy it and run the complete pipeline to produce SFT-ready data. The next step is a controlled large-scale evaluation of student accuracy, faithfulness, and cost; the present preprint deliberately reports the system and its artifact validation rather than an efficacy claim.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了从前沿闭源模型中提取思维链的实际限制。 三种具有代表性的最先进提取方法——强制推理、草稿状态重放和加密块重放——在通过标准聊天补全接口访问 Claude-Sonnet-5.5 时，均未返回任何思维链 token。 这些失败源于四项接口限制，而非实现错误。 因此，我们提出了 Recast，它将问题从提取隐藏的推理过程重新框架为从最终答案重建可审计的推理过程。 Recast 结合了数据集感知的答案引出、第一人称重建、防御性清洗、答案规范化以及经过验证的 SFT 数据流水线。 据我们所知，这是首个在不使用隐藏推理通道的情况下，从 Claude-Sonnet-5.5、GPT-6.1 和 Gemini 3 等前沿闭源模型重建思维链的系统。 该系统是开源的，并打包为智能体技能，因此只需一个提示词即可部署它并运行完整流水线，生成可直接用于 SFT 的数据。 下一步是对学生模型的准确率、忠实度和成本进行受控的大规模评估；本预印本有意报告该系统及其工件验证，而非给出有效性声明。
